+# Financial-2525
+
+**v.000_r.001 · Version 000 · revision 0.001** · Vision • 2525 Level-3 Domain Play — the MoT Financial System
+
+> A personal pilot on the operator's own figures. Money on this surface is a RECORD of what a person typed, never advice, never a bank; the cloud half is best-effort and says so.
+
+Mode: **Manual (MODE_R-CORE_SPEC: no commit without a named Human-Authority event)** · phase **pilot** · route `/main/Financial-2525` · ledger `docs/traceability/financial-2525.ledger.json`
+
+Tenant: personal — the business frame is declared and tested only after the personal framework has received feedback (operator addendum 5)
+
+## MoT — the measure of time, in A.B..C
+
+A MoT (Measure of Time) is ONE WHOLE — a pay period, a budget month, a financial year. A moment inside it is its elapsed fraction in Base-3600: A = 3600ths of the MoT (0 at the start, 3600 at completion) · B = 3600ths of an A · C = 3600ths of a B. The start reads 0.0000..0000 and the end reads 3600.3600..3600 — exactly the celestial UCRS-2525 orbit (HU 0 = perihelion, 3600 = a full orbit). The scale never names a planet; only the LTU conversion knows how many local seconds the whole holds, so the same record converts to Mars and later planets.
+
+| | |
+|---|---|
+| FULL | `3600.3600..3600` — the Equal writings `3600.0000..0000` · `3600.3600..3600` · `3599.3599..3599` |
+| Stamp | `YYYY.MM.DD_HH.MM..SS (CST standard, UTC−6, no daylight shift — Austin, Texas)` |
+| Duration | `0000.00.DD_HH.MM..SS (33 days = 0000.00.33_00.00..00 · 16.5 days = 0000.00.16_12.00..00)` |
+| LTU | D 1 · W 7 · M 33 · Q 99 · Y 365 · 1440 min/day |
+| Pay MoT | 30.333 days — one third of a 91-day quarter (91 ÷ 3 = 30.333…) — the operator's worked example; one A = 728 s · one B = 0.2022 s · one C = 0.0000562 s |
+| ◬ ♡ 웃 | ♡ M_LTU — local time, the witness · 웃 M_33 — the 33-day personal month · ◬ M_SS — the sub-second 3600 scale, the machine's clock |
+| Project value | ♡ = minutes · 웃 = minutes × minimum wage · ◬ = minutes × efficiency gain → traded for $ |
+
+## The calendar
+
+PERIHELION — day 1 of every Financial-2525 year begins at the perihelion instant (the SoI calendar's own anchor; Celestial-2525's HU 0). CST standard (UTC−6, fixed) — how a day is NAMED; the instants are universal.
+
+| | |
+|---|---|
+| Quarter | 91 days |
+| Grid | 364 days |
+| Down day | 365 — day 365, and whatever fraction of the orbit remains until the next perihelion, is the DOWN day — no quarter owns it |
+| Personal frames | 33 · 66 · 99 days |
+| Analysis units | D 1 · W 7 · M 33 · Q 99 · Y 365 |
+| Business grid | 4-4-5 weeks · 13 weeks · 91 days per quarter (declared, test later) |
+| Perihelion table | frontend/lib/financial-2525/calendar.ts — 2024–2035 SOURCED (Espenak via the Farmers' Almanac, EST→UTC; NASA APOD 2025; EarthSky 2026); outside the table DECLARED and shown as such |
+
+Discrepancies on the record:
+
+- 2028: 12:28 UTC here (Espenak) vs 12:11 UTC in the older lib/soi-calendar.ts seed — recorded, not hidden
+- 2027: 02:33 UTC (Espenak/Almanac) vs 02:07 UTC (in-the-sky.org) — the Almanac value carried
+
+## Escrow releases $/min
+
+The payer puts a period's pay UP FRONT into escrow (two weeks or one month for a business). From the deposit day and time the escrow releases amount ÷ (MoT × 1440) per minute, linearly, for the MoT. Released money is visible at once; it is WITHDRAWABLE only from 3 hours after the deposit. A withdrawal is its own transaction and can never take more than is withdrawable then.
+
+Hold: **3 hours**. States: `pending` → `releasing` → `released`.
+
+Invariants:
+
+- money released is never more than money deposited
+- a withdrawal never makes the available balance negative
+- the rate is amount ÷ MoT-minutes and nothing else
+- a transaction is amount · deposit day and time · MoT — always the three fields
+- the record is append-only and chain-hashed
+

+|---|---|
+| Amount | $3,604.49 |
+| Posted | 2026-09-29 |
+| Deposit | `2026.10.01_07.00..00` |
+| MoT | 30.333 days |
+| Memo | PAYROLL · PENDING DIRECT DEPOSIT |
+| Rate | $0.0825/min · $4.95/hour · $118.83/day · $0.001375/sec |
+| Withdrawable at +3 h | $14.85 |
+
+> the operator's own paycheck, transcribed from his bank screen; a record, never an invention
+
+## The personal budget
+
+Categories: Income · Home · Auto · Insurance · Utilities · Fitness · Fun · Groceries · Dining Out · Other — kinds income / fixed / variable. Ladder: $/day · $/hour · $/min · $/sec and per D · W · M33 · Q99 · Y365 (the sheet's 144 $/D = 0.1 $/m · 1,008 $/W · 4,752 $/M33 · 14,256 $/Q99).
+
+| line | per 33 days |
+|---|---:|
+| Income | $3,200 |
+| Home | $700 |
+| Auto | $1,800 |
+| Insurance | $200 |
+| Utilities | $150 |
+| Groceries | $300 |
+| Fitness | $50 |
+| Fun | $200 |
+
+Sheet slips recorded, not fixed:
+
+- 47,620 min written for 33 days (33 × 1440 = 47,520)
+- 4,762 $/M33 written (0.1 $/min × 47,520 = 4,752; the quarter figure 14,256 = 3 × 4,752 is consistent)
+
+## Tokenization
+
+Tokenization honours the 9,999 HI (웃) token cap — the YUG_CEILING the POD session already enforces (frontend/lib/pod-yug.ts); Financial-2525 reuses it and never declares a second ceiling. Cap **9999**. declared for revision 0.001; wired when the personal framework has received feedback.
+

+
+Grid 4-4-5 · 13 weeks · 91 days. P&L ladder: Revenue − COGS = Margin − R&D − Marketing − Sales − SG&A = Operating Income − DA = EBITDA − DA = EBIT. the business pays two weeks or one month up front; the same accrual law releases it to each person at $/min.
